event_date_policy.other_events: Use the recovered delivery dates as known event coverage; a single day is not a claim that a multi-day conference lasted only one day.

decisions: Keep all 90 reviewed delivery entries, including split tutorial slots.
Modern Perl and Modern PERL are different talks, as Dave confirmed.
Use approved groups and otherwise match full titles, ignoring trivial punctuation/case; preserve Modern PERL separately.
Keep different Teaching Perl/Perl Training and provisional Writing Books titles separate pending stronger identity evidence.
Retain all research notes, source URLs, precision and original titles in backfill_source.record_json.
Keep both legacy Googlejuice talk records; disambiguate their URLs without deleting either.
